Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 23 now!
Synopsis :
An emotional Mura confronts Chankya for sending Chandragupta in Dhananand's palace. Chanakya reveals his real intentions to Mura that he wants to draw Chandragupta's attention towards Dhananand's wrongdoing. Dhananand suspects Mura but she clevely inculcates in Dhananand's head that his friend, Seleucus can be the one who is conspiring against him. An irritated Dhananand burns the gift sent by Seleucus. Later, Chandragupta is shocked as his friends go against him after following Chanakya's instructions.
